design_philosophy: Aesthetic conviction over compromise. A trust-first architecture focusing on institutional credibility, sophisticated data presentation, and premium corporate positioning. Avoids generic SaaS aesthetics in favor of 'Old Money Tech' - conveying authority, stability, and high-end B2B consultancy.

typography.font_strategy: The 'Old Money Tech' Pair: Classic Serif Head + Clean Sans Body

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing. Tailwind scale heavily relying on p-8, p-12, p-16, p-24 for macro sections to create breathing room. Container layouts should feel structural and deliberate, utilizing strict grid systems.
spacing_and_layout.bento_grid: For the 'Tipos de Garantias' section, use MODE B: THE CONTROL ROOM GRID strategy adapted for marketing. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-6. Flat solid cards with sharp 1px borders.
spacing_and_layout.hero_overlay: For hero images: bg-primary/70 or a dark gradient to ensure text readability while allowing the premium corporate imagery to shine.

components.buttons: Flat, sharp edges or rounded-sm (max 4px). High contrast. Primary CTA uses Deep Navy (#0A2540) or Metallic Gold/Ochre (#C89D66) on hover. Always explicitly set hover text color.
components.cards: Solid white backgrounds, 1px subtle border (border-slate-200), zero or very diffuse ambient shadow (shadow-sm). Hover state adds subtle lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-lg.
components.navigation: Sticky header (z-50) using Glassmorphism (Crystal clear, backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/90) with a 1px delicate bottom border (border-slate-200/50).
components.icons: Use lucide-react (stroke-width: 1.5) for a sophisticated, lightweight technical look.

sections: Hero: Full width banner, Playfair Display heading, strong dual CTAs ('Solicitar Cotação', 'Fale com Especialista'), corporate skyscraper background.
Trust Bar: 'Mais de 10 anos de experiência' + logos/stats.
Vantagens: 6 items grid with clean icons.
Garantias (Serviços): Bento grid of the 8 types of guarantees.
CTA Section: High contrast (Navy bg, white text, Gold button).
Footer: Deep Navy background, corporate info, links, address.

technical_instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a WhatsApp floating button fixed to bottom right (z-50).
Use framer-motion for subtle entrance animations (staggered fade-up) typical of premium corporate sites.
Implement the contact form purely visually (UI only, no backend).
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button').
Use Shadcn UI primitives for all forms.
Use lucide-react for all iconography to maintain a clean, high-end look.
